bio.text: Brian Romero is the Democratic nominee for the open New York State Assembly District 34 seat in western Queens, after winning the June 2026 primary; City Limits described him as 36 years old and running unopposed in November.

He worked for about four and a half years as chief of staff to Assemblymember Jessica González-Rojas, then as chief of staff and legislative aide to State Sen. Kristen Gonzalez, a job he left in March 2026.
City Limits reported that he spent about a decade living in Ravenswood Houses, a NYCHA development between Astoria and Long Island City.

sources.title: Q&A: Brian Romero Brings a NYCHA Perspective to Queens Assembly Seat
